text:
dinesh: eu-central GPU pool telemetry spiking — enqueue latency up, ~90% preemptible evictions, a bunch of in-flight requests hitting 500s. putting this here :rotating_light:

pagerbot: ALERT: region eu-central GPU pool degraded. Incident created: IN-2026-1123. Paging oncall rotation.

oncall-jordan: I'm on it. pulling logs + checking fabric and autoscaler history. Any recent model rollout or infra changes?

carla: no model rollouts. saw autoscaler thrash ~3x in the past 18m (scale down then surge up). looks like reclaim/preemptible churn.

dinesh: can we tilt traffic off eu-central for latency-sensitive routes? propose critical -> eu-west2, best-effort -> hosted fallback. want to avoid user-facing 5xx.

ben: +1. starting a 10% canary tilt now. executing traffic shift job.

ben: /run job traffic-shift --from=eu-central --to=eu-west2 --percent=10 --reason="eviction-thrash"

pagerbot: Job accepted: traffic-shift ts-9876. Estimated completion: ~90s. Notifying ops.

oncall-jordan: seeing 10% shift live. eu-west2 p95 for critical increased 120ms -> 160ms but still within SLO. headroom available.

eva: propose a small paging tweak while autoscaler is actively scaling: suppress immediate escalation for low-priority infra alerts in the degraded region (avoid noisy paging). putting config suggestion below.

dinesh: ```
# pagerbot snippet - proposal
rules:
  - scope: region=="eu-central" and region_state=="degraded"
    priority: low
    action:
      delay_minutes: 10
      escalate_if_unresolved: true
```

carla: LGTM. Also recommend a runbook step before widening traffic shift: drain preemptible nodes to reduce churn, then evaluate.

ben: draining preemptible pool now:
`kubectl get nodes -l instance-type=preemptible -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

pagerbot: Action logged: preemptible drain started by ben.

oncall-jordan: pager suppression looks reasonable. i'm enabling it for next 30m while we stabilize. will monitor metrics and error budget burn.

sre-lead-anna: ack, i'll take over monitoring after Jordan's 30m window and coordinate capacity bump if needed.

dinesh: creating follow-up ticket INF-3245: "eu-central capacity review + pagerbot policy update". assigning to platform-ops.

ben: :thumbsup: noted cost impact — shifting critical traffic to eu-west2 will raise west2 spend ~12% while tilt active. tracker updated.

pagerbot: Incident IN-2026-1123 status: partial-mitigated. Active mitigations: traffic-tilt(10%), preemptible-drain. Links: https://redwood.example/incident/IN-2026-1123

oncall-jordan: handoff note: i'll watch for 30m then hand to @sre-lead-anna. leaving a short runbook summary in the ticket.

sre-lead-anna: acknowledged. will pick up and run capacity plan if degradation persists.

dinesh: thanks everyone. filing the pagerbot policy PR after incident for review and adding a small test in our infra-e2e harness.

pagerbot: Pager suppression enabled for low-priority alerts in eu-central for 30m (actioned by dinesh).

carla: closing loop — if we see renewed eviction rate >70% after tilt we'll consider spinning dedicated reserved nodes as short-term relief.

ben: noted — tracking that in INF-3245.

pagerbot: Incident IN-2026-1123: last update 1962110320.
